com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:prices:write consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Writes approved listing prices and normal pricing history, cache, notifications and marketplace-sync state; no stock, order or automation settings change.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: Unconfirmed, expired or changed proposals are refused. Uncertain outcomes require checking current prices before retrying.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Fresh recommendations, ongoing repricing and publishing are outside this operation.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Apply only the exact card prices explicitly confirmed by the user.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns per-listing applied, skipped or uncertain outcomes and their totals; a batch can partially succeed.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use after a reviewed preparation returns signed tokens for those confirmed prices; confirmed must be true.
